hints: Notice the options mix $\text{g cm}^{-3}$ and $\text{kg m}^{-3}$ for the density of sand, so check what $1 \text{ g cm}^{-3}$ means in $\text{kg m}^{-3}$.
Compare sand to water at $1000 \text{ kg m}^{-3}$ - sand grains sink in water and are made of rock-like material, so expect a value a few times larger than water.
Convert the $2 \times 10^2$ and $2 \times 10^3$ values in $\text{g cm}^{-3}$ to $\text{kg m}^{-3}$ and ask which converted value is close to a solid a little denser than water.
walkthrough: Recall the reference density of water: $\rho = 1000 \text{ kg m}^{-3} = 1 \text{ g cm}^{-3}$. Any common rock or sand must be denser than this because it sinks.
Recall the unit conversion: $1 \text{ g} = 10^{-3} \text{ kg}$ and $1 \text{ cm}^3 = 10^{-6} \text{ m}^3$, so $1 \text{ g cm}^{-3} = 1000 \text{ kg m}^{-3}$.

Apply this to the options in $\text{g cm}^{-3}$: $2 \times 10^2 \text{ g cm}^{-3} = 200000 \text{ kg m}^{-3}$ and $2 \times 10^3 \text{ g cm}^{-3} = 2000000 \text{ kg m}^{-3}$, both impossibly large for a common solid.

Check the options in $\text{kg m}^{-3}$: $2 \times 10^1 \text{ kg m}^{-3} = 20 \text{ kg m}^{-3}$ is much less dense than water or air-like packing, while $2 \times 10^3 \text{ kg m}^{-3} = 2000 \text{ kg m}^{-3}$ is about twice water.
Sand is mostly quartz grains with density a little above $2000 \text{ kg m}^{-3}$, so the only reasonable estimate is $2 \times 10^3 \text{ kg m}^{-3}$. This is option D.

options.A: A density of $2 \times 10^2 \text{ g cm}^{-3}$ equals $200000 \text{ kg m}^{-3}$, about 100 times denser than rock and impossible for sand.
options.B: A density of $2 \times 10^3 \text{ g cm}^{-3}$ equals $2000000 \text{ kg m}^{-3}$, far greater than any common solid and wrong by a factor of 1000 in unit conversion.
options.C: A density of $2 \times 10^1 \text{ kg m}^{-3}$ is about 50 times less dense than water, more like a light foam than sand which sinks in water.
options.D: A density of $2 \times 10^3 \text{ kg m}^{-3}$ is about twice the density of water, which is reasonable for sand made of rock grains.
